clips.title: The story
paras: Around Blackfathom Deeps, naga rites leave Kor gems corrupted. Spellcasters prize the stones for holding arcane force, but this taint must be cleansed before a gem can be used in righteous smithing.

Kor gems can capture and hold great stores of magic, making them prized by sorcerers and enchanted smiths. Near the ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, naga oracles and tide priestesses claim the stones for their shadowy rites. Their foul enchantments warp each gem with corruption from the sea. The taint does not drain the stone's latent power, so those who need a potent focus still seek gems among the naga.
